_comment: OpenRouter USD/1M-token price snapshot consumed by src/bixiascribe/pricing.py. Regenerate with scripts/refresh_prices.py -- do not hand-edit prompt_usd_per_1m/completion_usd_per_1m without also bumping fetched_at. Keys are the exact model id string used in eval/model_variants.json (the "openrouter/..." litellm-prefixed form) -- pricing.load_prices() looks up by that exact string, no normalization. 'provider' is the OpenRouter provider slug this snapshot was pinned to (see LLM_PROVIDER_ONLY in .env.example); '' means OpenRouter's own default routing (unpinned), which is what every historical out/generation_runs*.jsonl row actually ran under.

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.2._note: Novita's price for this model moved between two fetches minutes apart during this snapshot (0.3388/1.0648 -> 0.7406/2.3276) -- some OpenRouter providers run dynamic/spot pricing for high-end models. Treat this entry as approximate; re-run scripts/refresh_prices.py before trusting a cost comparison involving this model.
